insights.summary: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue more than doubled (+119%) to ₹252 Cr, with EBITDA of ₹49 Cr (19.4% margin) and PAT of ₹33 Cr; the new plant contributed about ₹115 Cr and exports rose 177% to ₹50 Cr+. Management kept the ~₹2,000 Cr revenue goal at 80% utilisation in FY28, expects exports of ~₹200 Cr and ~₹40 Cr from oil coolers this year, and guided EBITDA margin of 20%+ at scale. A ₹350 Cr QIP closed in late June; the company plans ~₹100 Cr of new capex (Bangalore and a Bus AC/railway plant) and says it needs no new debt for two years.

what_changed.text: ~₹2,000 Cr revenue at 80% utilisation in FY28 ('still same')
Exports ~₹200 Cr in FY27; Q1 ₹50 Cr+
~₹100 Cr capex for a Bangalore plant and a Bus AC/railway plant
Oil coolers ~₹40 Cr in FY27; L1 in a CLW tender
Bus AC bulk revenue now in Q3-Q4 after a new MOU

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: So, we are on in line to achieve around INR200 crores.

analyst_questions.answer: Headcount now 1,500+ with full teams for Bus AC and the new plant.
Liquid cooling uses plate heat exchangers inside, but fin-and-tube still needed outside the rack.
Freight up from ~$1,500 to ~$6,000 a container; UAE still slow, North America and Europe making up for it.
QIP covers two years of growth; ₹100 Cr capex from profits; no plan given for surplus cash.

red_flags.text: Equity dilution: promoters down to 65.7% from 70.8% after the ₹350 Cr QIP (Screener shareholding).
Standalone EBITDA rose only 25% on 59% higher revenue; margin gains came from the subsidiary.
New ₹100 Cr capex announced soon after saying capex was largely done.
PLI and RIPS incentives not yet booked; eligibility depends on reaching ₹400 Cr fin-and-tube sales.

watch_next: Q2 revenue growth and new-plant contribution (Q1 ~₹115 Cr)
Bus AC revenue after the new MOU supply starts
EBITDA margin near 20% and any RIPS/PLI income
